simple: AI-powered next-generation antivirus in one lightweight agent managed from the cloud: installs in minutes without a reboot and needs no daily signature updates. Stops malware, ransomware and more sophisticated attacks, including fileless ones, on Windows, macOS and Linux computers and servers — online and offline. Controls the use of USB drives, SD cards and Thunderbolt devices. Also protects Android and iOS smartphones: spots malicious activity and keeps unauthorized users away from corporate data. Help with installation and setup — Express Support. Centrally manages the host firewall: policies are created and enforced from one console. Blocking combines machine learning, AI-powered indicators of attack (IOAs), exploit blocking and high-performance memory scanning. EDR (Falcon Insight XDR) continuously records what happens on every computer, detects and prioritizes malicious activity on its own, and lets you investigate and stop the attack. CrowdStrike experts hunt for threats in your environment around the clock (Falcon Adversary OverWatch), looking for faint signs of sophisticated intrusions. Identity protection (Falcon Identity Protection), IT hygiene, SIEM and the 24/7 managed Falcon Complete service (MDR) are sold separately.
